text_en: A Psalm. A Song at the dedication of the temple. Of David.
I will extol you, O Lord , for you have drawn me up, and did not let my foes rejoice over me.
text_cn: 上主，我称扬你，因为你救拔了我， 你也没有使我的仇敌向我自夸。

text_en: O Lord my God, I cried to you for help, and you have healed me.
text_cn: 上主，我一向你呼号， 我主，你便医治了我。

text_en: O Lord , you brought up my soul from Sheol, restored me to life from among those gone down to the Pit.
text_cn: 上主，你由阴府中把我救出， 又使我安全复生，免降幽谷。

text_en: Sing praises to the Lord , O you his faithful ones, and give thanks to his holy name.
text_cn: 上主的圣民，请向上主歌颂，称谢他的圣名。

text_en: For his anger is but for a moment; his favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may linger for the night, but joy comes with the morning.
text_cn: 因为他的忿怒，瞬息消散； 他的恩爱却要终生绵延。 晚间虽令人哭涕，清晨却使人欢喜。

text_en: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved. ”
text_cn: 我曾自夸过说： “我永不会动摇。”

text_en: By your favor, O Lord , you had established me as a strong mountain; you hid your face; I was dismayed.
text_cn: 上主，你恩待了我，使我立足于稳固的山岗； 但是你一掩面，我便立即感觉到失措惊惶。

text_en: To you, O Lord , I cried, and to the Lord I made supplication:
text_cn: 上主，我曾向你呼号， 我曾向我主哀求说：

text_en: “What profit is there in my death, if I go down to the Pit? Will the dust praise you? Will it tell of your faithfulness?
text_cn: “我如果降入阴府，我的血于你何益？ 灰土岂能赞美你，或宣扬你的忠义？

text_en: Hear, O Lord , and be gracious to me! O Lord , be my helper! ”
text_cn: 上主，请俯听我，怜悯我； 上主，求你前来助佑我。”

text_en: You have turned my mourning into dancing; you have taken off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
text_cn: 你把我的哀痛，给我变成了舞蹈， 脱去了我的苦衣给我披上喜乐；

text_en: so that my soul may praise you and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks to you forever.
text_cn: 为此，我的心灵歌颂你，永不止息； 上主，我的天主，我要永远称谢你！
